title: Zero Sum: Nine Lives
summary: On a rain-slick bridge, your partner hangs from the rail and the suspect’s taillights are disappearing. Choose what Alex does next in a police-noir manga with nine endings.
summaryZhTW: 雨夜的斷橋上，搭檔攀著護欄，嫌犯的車尾燈逐漸遠去。在這部有九種結局的黑色警匪漫畫裡，由你決定艾力克斯的下一步。
coverAlt: Two squad cars chase a van along a rain-slick highway beneath the Zero Sum title.
controls: Read and choose with a mouse, touch or keyboard. After an ending, revisit a decision from that route.

approval.note: Creator requested publication of the revised manga in Possibility.
